crossRefs.note: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

parallels.note: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of…

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
translations.bsb: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
translations.kjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
translations.asv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
